item.title: 🚨 ▶️ Ownership Control Assessment (OCA) in EDF: new procedure The scope of the OCA procedure has been extended based on ...
item.description: 🚨 ▶️ Ownership Control Assessment (OCA) in EDF: new procedure The scope of the OCA procedure has been extended based on new Art. 136 of the Financial Regulation 2024/2509, leading to a more detailed and practice-oriented guidance, including: - Clarified ownership & control assessment criteria - Concrete examples, validity period, specific cases - Checks of intermediate ownership layers - New participants joining an action - Loss of eligibility scenarios - Expanded guidance on guarantees process - Clearer procedures for informing concerned entities 🔎 The new 2026 Ownership Control Declaration template must be used by the applicants and can be found under the Funding & Tenders Portal → EDF Reference Documents → Templates & Forms → Application Forms. The key difference compared to the old template is the difference between EU-controlled and non-EU controlled declarations (now more detailed, with non-EU countries identification, indication if those are eligible under specific calls). ▶️ Good to know: 📍 OCA validity period has been extended up to 36 months, 📍 OCA average process lasts 3 months, and work cannot begin before the entity (e.g. subcontractor, third party..) is validated (costs incurred not eligible for EU funding before) 📍 Ownership changes need to be notified immediately to DG DEFIS 👍 More information and tutorials available on the EDF official webpage: https://lnkd.in/ecnGG66U hashtag #EUDefenseIndustry Léo B. item.title: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual w...
item.description: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual work programme under the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), a new EU initiative meant to strengthen and modernise Europe’s defence industry, ramp-up production capacity and secure Europe’s technological edge and resilience. 📍Over EUR 700 million of EDIP are dedicated to reinforcing European defence production. European companies can apply to receive funding for Industrial Reinforcement Actions (IRA) and increase their manufacturing capacities for energetic components, key electronic components, and defence platforms and end-products. Two additional calls dedicated to Ukraine (USI-IRA) aim at reinforcing Ukrainian defence industrial production capacity in terms of missiles, ammunition and bombs and (counter-)drone systems. 📍 Funding rates for successful projects are between 35-100% of eligible project costs, depending on the respective call. First calls will open on 30 April and the very first call on energetic components will already close mid-June. ➡️ More details on the new EDIP webpage (tutorial videos, factsheets, timelines, application process) => https://lnkd.in/ePQrbrWG Léo B. item.title: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows...
item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. Léo B. item.description: 🚨🚨 EDF Work Programme 2026 released! 🚨🚨 Today, the EDF Work Programme 2026 was adopted by the Commission. All work programme files are available on DEFIS’ website: https://lnkd.in/efjYmBqp. The European Defence Fund’s annual Work Programme for 2026 will dedicate €1 billion to support collaborative defence R&D projects. With this new round of investments, the European Commission’s flagship for defence R&D will address 31 collaborative defence R&D topics, in critical and urgent areas in line with the commonly agreed capability development priorities. ▶️ More information on the dedicated press release: https://lnkd.in/eWeVzM-p. item.description: ▶️ Save The Date! 📅 3-4 June 2026 ENDR Conference Gijón 2026 - “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry” In the framework of The European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Asturias Hub defensa ( ASTURIAS HUB DE DEFENSA) - Asturias Technology Business Association for the development of the Defence Industry - will host the European conference “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry”. 🗺️ The event will take place Gijón, Asturias (Spain), on 3-4 June 2026, at the Laboral Centro de Arte y Creación Industrial. 🔎 The conference will bring together key policymakers, industry leaders, SMEs, and stakeholders from the defence and dual-use entrepreneurial ecosystem, alongside civilian technology innovators, clusters, and defence business associations. It will also engage academia, research and technology organisations, higher education and VET providers, research funding bodies, specialised media, as well as EU, national, and regional authorities, and international organisations. Registration: https://lnkd.in/eT2Hjm8T Léo B. item.description: 🔙 Be kind: rewind. Last June 18th, the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All team gathered at the Paris Air Show the EDF interested organisations during a matchmaking event held on Wednesday 18 June evening at the French National Air & Space Museum. The EOA consortium partner Systematic Paris-Region together with EEN TONIC organized this event and welcomed SMEs, startups, large firms and other types of organizations to take part in prescheduled meetings as well as informal networking around the upcoming EDF funding opportunities. We thank all the registered participants who came and are looking forward to organizing other similar events in the future!
